limitations.en: Cannot be applied to incompatible or non-infusable armaments; affinity choices can depend on owned whetblades.

relevantNotes.en: Official Brazilian Portuguese localization and FP cost remain pending direct in-game verification.

primaryAcquisition.en: Guaranteed Loot: Jagged Peak * Found on Igon's body if he was summoned to help kill Bayle the Dread (Igon needs to have been summoned for the successful attempt, but need not have survived). ** WARNING: This Ash of War will not be gained if Bayle is killed without Igon having been summoned, or if Igon is killed by the player.

primaryAcquisition.en: Guaranteed Loot: Shadow Keep * Found pre-equipped to the Dueling Shield, which in turn is found by taking the stairs up on the other side of the statue at the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace then taking a left and going up the first stairs to the right. Continue on that path to another set of stairs to another floor up to find a balcony to the right. Get past the Fire Knight there then go to the bridge on the left and jump off its left side onto a small stone pillar leading to a small stone floor with the loot.
